layers.name: Chakras

items.name: Sahasrara

fields.note: One copy of the table on your whiteboard says "violent"; the other copy and the Universal Map say violet.

items.placement: Just above the crown of the skull (the top of the parietal bones), where the sushumna ends.

items.name: Ajna
items.placement: Inside the head at eyebrow height, on the sushumna line beside the third ventricle, behind the point between the eyebrows.

items.name: Visuddha
items.placement: At throat height, level with the thyroid cartilage (Adam's apple, about C4–C5), on the sushumna line in the cervical spine.

items.name: Anahata
items.placement: At heart height (the centre of the four heart chambers, mid-thoracic spine), on the sushumna line.

items.name: Manipura
items.placement: At navel height (the umbilicus sits at about the L3–L4 disc), on the sushumna line. Some modern sources put it higher, at the solar plexus around T12–L1.

items.name: Svadhisthana
items.placement: At the level of the sacrum (its centre, about S2), on the sushumna line in the sacral canal.

items.name: Muladhara
items.placement: At the base of the spine (the tip of the coccyx), where the sushumna begins. Its point on the body surface is the perineum.

layers.about: The seven chakras from your mystical septenary, placed on the sushumna line at their traditional heights. Symbols are your Canva chakra icons.

layers.name: Nadis & kundalini

items.name: Sushumna

fields.v: Through the middle of the body, from the base of the spine to the crown

items.placement: Traced through the real central canal: from the tip of the coccyx up the sacral canal and lumbar cistern (around the cauda equina), into the central canal of the spinal cord, through the central canal of the medulla, the fourth ventricle, the aqueduct of the midbrain and the third ventricle. The last stretch, from the third ventricle to the crown, has no anatomical canal; it is drawn straight up to the top of the skull.

items.name: Ida

fields.v: Boaz: negative polarity - ida - yin - lady of evolution

fields.note: Your board lists THA (MOON) and HA (SUN); pairing tha with ida and ha with pingala is the traditional reading of hatha.

items.placement: Starts at the left of muladhara, crosses the sushumna at each chakra up to ajna (left, right, left, right, left between them) and ends at the left nostril, passing through the nasal cavity. Distance from the centre line between crossings: 2.8 cm.

items.name: Pingala

fields.v: Jachin: positive polarity - pingala - yang - lady of creation

fields.note: Your board lists THA (MOON) and HA (SUN); pairing tha with ida and ha with pingala is the traditional reading of hatha.

items.placement: Mirror of ida: starts at the right of muladhara, crosses the sushumna at each chakra up to ajna and ends at the right nostril.

items.name: Kundalini
items.placement: Drawn as 3½ coils at the base of the spine (muladhara, at the tip of the coccyx), the traditional resting form. When it rises it travels up the sushumna.

layers.about: Sushumna through the real central canal, ida and pingala crossing at each chakra to the nostrils, and kundalini coiled at the base.
